summary: Tested live landing, dashboard, transactions, nota basics, and backend validation. Seeded dashboard/API values matched expected baseline; transaction CRUD and filtering passed. Nota form preview worked, but the browser run did not observe the newly saved QA nota after clicking Simpan Nota.

integration_issues.issue: After filling Toko QA / Telur QA / qty 2 / price 200000, clicking nota-save-button did not result in an observable Toko QA row within the wait window; status/print/delete could not be completed in that run.

action_items: Investigate nota-save-button request/state refresh and reproduce the missing saved row; then retest nota status, print, delete, and dashboard unpaid-banner updates.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend mutation errors are toast-only and the nota mutation has no explicit response/error instrumentation; ensure failed save is visibly surfaced and query invalidation reliably refreshes the list.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted temporary Test masuk QA, Test keluar QA, and no confirmed persistent Toko QA nota remained.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing canvas/title and dashboard baseline passed. Transaction incoming/outgoing creation, search, and deletion passed. Nota preview total passed, but save-to-list was not observed; mobile overflow was not reached after the nota failure.
rca of the issue: Not established. The page remained on the filled nota form after the save click and no Toko QA row was observed; inspect browser network/API response and mutation state during reproduction.
